name: done
title_zh: 验收先于归档，拿证据才算做完的任务收尾员
tagline_zh: 你说「做完了」它不当真，先查日志、产物、接口回包，证据齐了才归档。专治口头完工、事后返工。
tagline_en: Says 'done'? It won't take your word—checks logs, artifacts, API replies first. Kills hand-wave closings. Thai.
desc_en: Verification-first task completion — gathers fresh evidence before marking a task done and archiving it. Use when the user says a task is finished or wants to close it out. Trigger words include "done", "mark this complete", "ปิดงาน", "เสร็จแล้ว".
why_zh: 把「完成」从感觉变成可复核状态：每次归档前强制采集新鲜证据，缺一项就拦下追问。
why_en: Turns 'done' from a feeling into a checkable state: forces fresh evidence before every archive, blocks on gaps—kills 'I thought.
limit_zh: 只认可脚本化验证的证据（文件、日志、命令输出）；纯主观判断（设计好看、用户满意）它管不了。没有可执行验证命令的任务。
limit_en: Only accepts scriptable evidence (files, logs, command output). Subjective calls like 'looks good' are out of scope; without a verifiable command.
title_en: Evidence-first task closer: verify before you archive
